A **smoke test** is the fast, critical check you run first: is the app up, and
does the core journey work? Tag it `smoke` so you can run only those tests with
`robot --include smoke` before committing to the full suite.

Close Part 2 by writing a tagged reachability check.

## Task 1 — Tag a reachability test as smoke

**Goal:** create `checks/shop_smoke.robot` with one `smoke`-tagged test that signs
`primary_user` in and confirms the catalog is reachable.

Here is the same tagged reachability check as a different user. Adapt it to
`primary_user`.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Reviewer Can Reach The Shop
    [Tags]    smoke
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    reviewer_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** `Shop Is Reachable` carries the `smoke` tag.

<!-- hint -->
Give the test a `[Tags]    smoke` line first so `--include smoke` selects it.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Sign in as `primary_user` and confirm you arrived with
`Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Shop Is Reachable
    [Tags]    smoke
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run it green

Run only the smoke tests:

```bash
uv run robot --include smoke checks
```

**Check:** the smoke test passes — the shop is up and the core journey works.

That closes Part 2. Part 3 steps away from the browser to test an API directly —
the same Robot Framework, with faster feedback and no page to render.
